Concrete barriers and narrow channelized islands separate lanes efficiently for cars and trucks, but these same elements create a highly exclusionary layout for anyone not traveling by motor vehicle, reducing fairness in spatial provision.

No visible pedestrian crossing, refuge path, or protected non-motorized facility is present within the toll area, so the environment appears unsafe for any road user outside a vehicle.
